message.content:
I’m happy to help you add a new SQL server to your setup. To get started, I’ll need a few details: | Item | What we need | Why it matters | |------|---------------|----------------| | **Server type** | e.g., Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc. | Determines the connection string format and available options. | | **Hostname / IP** | `plgah.ca` (you already provided this) | The address the client will connect to. | | **Port** | Default ports: 1433 for SQL Server, 3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL, etc. | Some servers use non‑standard ports. | | **Database name** | The specific database you want to connect to (or leave blank to connect to the default). | Needed for the connection string. | | **Authentication method** | • Windows/Integrated (if applicable)
• SQL login (username/password)
• Azure AD / other | Determines how credentials are passed. | | **Username / Password** | If using SQL login. | Required for authentication. | | **SSL / encryption** | Do you need an encrypted connection? | Some servers require or recommend SSL. | | **Optional: Connection timeout** | Seconds before giving up on a connection attempt. | Helps with troubleshooting connectivity issues. | Once you provide those details, I can give you the exact connection string and show you how to add it in the DartFX application (or any other tool you’re using). If you’re unsure about any of the items above, let me know and I can guide you through checking them on the server side.
